import sys
shortest = sys.maxsize
for start in range(15):
    # BFS from start to find shortest cycle
    dist = {start:0}
    parent = {start:-1}
    queue = [start]
    while queue:
        x = queue.pop(0)
        for y in adj[x]:
            if y not in dist:
                dist[y] = dist[x]+1
                parent[y] = x
                queue.append(y)
            elif parent[x] != y and parent.get(y,-1) != x:
                # found a cycle
                cycle_len = dist[x] + dist[y] + 1
                if cycle_len > 0:
                    shortest = min(shortest, cycle_len)
print("Shortest cycle length:", shortest)

    parent = {start: -1}
